{{Top|leg}}
A '''Sector Officer''' was a member of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] in charge of a branch of the ISB in a given [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Sector Officers were given their assignments from the [[Commission of Operations]].
